description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustSelectToProvide" sourceRef="Task_SelectRouteDateTime" targetRef="Task_ProvideDetails"/>

  </bpmn:process>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_JourneyCompleted" name="Customer completes journey"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackRequested" name="Feedback or services offered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateToChannelSplit" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_ChannelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChannelToEmail" name="Email" sourceRef="Gateway_ChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_SendTicketEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChannelToSMS" name="SMS" sourceRef="Gateway_ChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_SendTicketSMS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmailToMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendTicketEmail" targetRef="Gateway_ChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SMSToMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendTicketSMS" targetRef="Gateway_ChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToInventory" sourceRef="Gateway_ChannelMerge" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InventoryToReminder" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Task_SendReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderToJourney" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Catch_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JourneyToFeedbackGateway" sourceRef="Catch_JourneyCompleted" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback" targetRef="End_Concluded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedback" targetRef="End_FeedbackRequested"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
